Stepper

The stepper consists of an increase button, a decrease button and an input box, which is used to input and adjust numbers within a certain range.(Minimum version: 24.9.0)

Import

Import components in app.json or index.json.

"usingComponents": {
  "maui-stepper": "@macle/maui/stepper/index"
}

Sample Code

Basic Usage

Set the input value through value, and you can monitor changes in the input value through the change event.

<maui-stepper value="{{ 1 }}" bind:change="onChange" />

Page({
  onChange(event) {
    console.log(event.detail);
  }
});

Step size setting

Use the step attribute to set the value that changes each time the increase or decrease button is clicked. The default is 1.

<maui-stepper value="{{ 1 }}" step="2" />

Limit input range

Limit the range of input values ​​via the min and max attributes.

<maui-stepper value="{{ 5 }}" min="5" max="8" />

Limit input to integers

After setting the integer attribute, the input box will be restricted to only integers.

<maui-stepper value="{{ 1 }}" integer />

Disabled state

Disable the stepper by setting the disabled attribute. In the disabled state, you cannot click the button or modify the input box.

<maui-stepper value="{{ 1 }}" disabled />

Disable long press

Determine whether the stepper enables long press gesture by setting the long-press attribute.

<maui-stepper value="{{ 1 }}" long-press="{{ false }}" />

Fixed decimal places

A fixed number of decimal places can be retained by setting the decimal-length property.

<maui-stepper value="{{ 1 }}" step="0.2" decimal-length="{{ 1 }}" />

Asynchronous changes

If you need to modify the value of the input box asynchronously, you can set the async-change attribute and manually modify value in the change event.

<maui-stepper value="{{ value }}" async-change bind:change="onChange" />

changeValue(val) {
    console.log(val);
    ma.showToast({
        title: 'Update in 2 seconds',
        duration: 2000,
        success: (res) => {
            setTimeout(() => {
                this.setData({
                    stepVal1: val.detail,
                });
            }, 2000);
        },
    });
}

Custom size

Set the input box width through the input-width property, and set the button size and input box height through the button-size property.

<maui-stepper value="{{ 1 }}" input-width="40px" button-size="32px" />

API

Props

Parameter Description Type Default Value
value input value String | Number minimum value
min minimum value String | Number 1
max maximum value String | Number -
step step size String | Number 1
integer Whether to only allow integers to be entered Boolean false
disabled Whether to disable Boolean false
disable-input Whether to disable the input box Boolean false
async-change Whether to enable asynchronous changes. Once enabled, the input value needs to be manually controlled. Boolean false
input-width Input box width, default unit is px String | Number 32px
button-size Button size, the default unit is px, the height of the input box will be consistent with the button size String | Number 28px
show-plus Whether to display the add button Boolean true
show-minus Whether to show the reduce button Boolean true
decimal-length Fixed number of decimal places displayed Number -
theme Style, optional value is round String -
disable-plus Whether to disable the add button Boolean -
disable-minus Whether to disable the reduce button Boolean -
long-press Whether to enable long press gesture Boolean true

Events

event name Description Callback parameter
bind:change Event triggered when bound value changes event.detail: currently entered value
bind:overlimit Fires when an unavailable button is clicked -
bind:plus Fires when the add button is clicked -
bind:minus Fires when the reduce button is clicked -
bind:focus Triggered when the input box is focused -
bind:blur Triggered when the input box is out of focus -
